title: A Talk with You

lines: Hi! I'm Jisu. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, too. I'm Ben.

qs: Do you like meeting new people? Why or why not?
What do you usually talk about with someone new?

items: introduce
to tell someone another person's name when they meet for the first time
Let me introduce my friend, Mina.
outgoing
friendly and happy to talk to new people
My sister is very outgoing.
hobby

paras: Small talk is a short, easy conversation about simple topics. People make small talk with neighbors, classmates, and even strangers at a bus stop.
Good topics are the weather, the weekend, food, and hobbies. It is better not to ask about money or age at first.
A good conversation is like a game of catch. You throw a question, and the other person throws one back.
Listen carefully, nod, and ask a follow-up question. For example, if someone says, "I like hiking," you can ask, "Where do you usually go?"

items: Small talk is about simple topics.

cards: It's your first day in a new class. Introduce yourself and ask one question to the person next to you.
